centerMethod: Per-limb island tube centers from BVH-accelerated raycast scans of the original 691k-tri mesh (three-mesh-bvh, DoubleSide): X-scans at multiple depths per height to isolate each limb island, Z-scans at the tube middle for depth. Column joints by anatomy: thoracic/lumbar vertebrae = back wall + 40-45 mm (hair segments excluded); waist inside abdomen (lordosis gap, not the hair mass behind it); skull center at ear height (1.735, ear width-jump in lateral scans); jaw pivot at mouth level mid-depth (TMJ midline equivalent); SC joints at sternal notch; femoral heads at inguinal crease level mid-pelvis; knee = epicondylar midpoint (tube mid), ankle = intermalleolar midpoint, midfoot = Chopart, toes = MTP. Heights kept from validated anthropometry (knee 27.5%, ankle 5.5%, elbow 65.8%, wrist 53.8% of 1.9029 m stature). IMPORTANT: leave marker mirroring OFF for this model - the right arm hangs ~40 mm more lateral than the left (measured), so mirroring displaces the right arm chain.
reapply: After estimate_rig_markers on this model: FIRST run {"type":"set_marker_mirroring","enabled":false} (the right arm is ~40 mm more lateral than the left - mirroring displaces it). Then set_transform each marker above, then set_transform each marker scale [0.7,0.7,0.7]. Positions are joint centers inside the volume (build uses positions only).

reference.anatomy: Standard rigging joint centers: femoral-head center, epicondylar midpoint (knee), intermalleolar midpoint (ankle), Chopart (midfoot), MTP (toes), glenohumeral center (shoulder), C7/neck base, ear-canal level skull center, TMJ-equivalent jaw pivot, SC joints, sacral/lumbar/thoracic vertebral bodies.
reference.source: Rigify human metarig axial heights (scripts/addons_core/rigify/metarigs/human.py) for hips/spine/waist/chest/neck/clavicle heights; limb heights validated vs anthropometry.
